text:
Maya: Quick sync — need to lock cuts for observability roadmap before exec on Fri. Customer asks: per-route cost breakdown, tracing hooks for cold-starts, and error-analytics drilldowns. What's feasible for the next release?

Alex: We can expose per-route cost in the console. Backend needs token-count + model mapping ingestion + a small job to rollup by route. UI work ~1 sprint, infra ~1 sprint.

Cheng: Tracing hooks are higher-risk. Proposal: phased. Phase 1 = sampled traces with basic span metadata (model, seq_len, backend node). Phase 2 = hook points in runtime for KV/cache miss spans and cold-start trace. Perf impact needs measurement.

Katie: Several enterprise customers pushed hard on error analytics — they want tenant-level grouping and a way to surface "repro prompts" for top errors. Pilot customers: SigmaHealth, NoteWave.

Maya: Suggested launch criteria (draft):
- Per-route cost visible in Console for all customers
- Tracing: sampled traces with link from request detail and <5% p50 overhead in canary
- Error analytics: aggregated counts + top-10 errors with drill-to-requests (no repro prompts in MVP)

Alex: If we have to cut, cut the repro prompts and deep request replay. Those are high-effort (privacy + storage). Per-route cost + basic errors + sampled traces feels doable.

Cheng: Alternative cut: full tracing only for Dedicated customers in initial rollouts; Hosted gets sampling at 2-5% and limited span retention. That reduces perf and storage risk.

Maya: Ok — decision for the meeting: MVP = per-route cost + sampled traces + aggregated error counts (no repro prompts). Roadmap: add trace hooks + repro prompts for Dedicated/pilot customers next quarter.

Maya: Rollout plan: canary to 5% traffic in week 1, expand to 25% week 2 if perf stable. Add a kill-switch and telemetry to measure p50/p95 token latency and CPU on inference nodes.

Alex: Implementation notes: we need a new ingestion pipeline (kafka topic) tagged by route+model and a daily rollup job. UI chart will show tokens/requests/cost by route.

Cheng: Sampling config (example):
```
trace.sampling.percentage = 2.5
trace.include_fields = [ "model", "route", "seq_len", "node_id" ]
```
Canary metrics: p50_latency, p95_latency, error_rate, inference_cpu.

Katie: I'll surface this to the two pilot customers and collect top 3 asks for error drilldowns. Will send a 3-question survey by EOD. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/obs-cost-trace-1734 — please add comments.

Maya: Thanks — will pull into roadmap doc and update exec slides. If anyone has a hard no on the cuts speak now.

Alex: No objections from Eng-Platform.

Cheng: No objections from SRE, but want a perf spike run before wide rollout.

Katie: No objections from CS. Will coordinate pilot signups.
